## ZGTA 5 — 1.1 beta 1
Solo Story, Free Roam and private multiplayer with proximity voice.

**Requirements**
iOS / iPadOS 15.0 or later, your own matching prepared game files, and an existing compatible TrollStore / TrollStore Lite setup. This package does not install TrollStore.

**Install or update**
Close GTA before installing. Update over the existing app to keep your game files, settings and saves. Removing this small installer package leaves the app and its data installed.

### 1.1 beta 1
- Uses the ZGTA 5 name and 1.x product versioning; Sileo package version is `1.1~beta1`.
- Keeps the same Build 109 app and existing data.
- Includes iPhone/browser proximity voice, smooth volume changes with distance, separate microphone and nearby-voice controls. These features passed the owner’s paired test; this naming update does not add a new gameplay build.
- Existing TrollStore installation method is unchanged; successful progress stays concise and full helper diagnostics remain available on failure.

Browser/Mac 1.2 is a separate release and does not change this iOS package.

[Earlier installer/build history](https://github.com/zemabinks/repo/blob/main/docs/zgta-v-changelog-archive.md#trollstore)
